name: Intel Open Image Denoise
scope: CPU device (all RIDs) and Metal device (osx-arm64 only) source profile with the trained weights. CUDA, HIP and SYCL devices, their external libraries, the apps, training scripts and documentation are excluded (see the component exclusions in dependency-imports.json).
reference: Licence check of the release archive: verdict PASS with build conditions (docs/RELEASE-LICENSE-PLAN.md, "OIDN build conditions"). Every imported file is Apache-2.0; the only proprietary text in the release (doc/BINARY-LICENSE.txt) is not imported.
buildConditions: OIDN_DEVICE_CPU ON on every RID; OIDN_DEVICE_METAL ON on osx-arm64 only
OIDN_DEVICE_CUDA, OIDN_DEVICE_HIP and OIDN_DEVICE_SYCL explicitly OFF on every RID
OIDN_APPS OFF; OIDN_INSTALL_DEPENDENCIES OFF (oneTBB ships from third_party/deps/tbb)
Ship LICENSE.txt and weights/LICENSE.txt with the OIDN libraries (the device modules are separate shared libraries)
